description: Publishes the three Amazon SES DKIM CNAMEs for the sending domain ([host.]domain) and the aopy branded link CNAME to Aopy's merchant edge. No root SPF. CNAMEs must stay DNS only (not proxied).
variableDescription: %dkim1%, %dkim2%, %dkim3%: the three Amazon SES DKIM tokens of this sending domain (32 lowercase letters or digits each); %edge%: the first label of Aopy's CloudFront routing endpoint for this environment (<edge>.cloudfront.net). All set by Aopy, never by the user.
